question: Which wheel-bearers will be told, and what union-joined rite gives all fruits?
premises: wheel-bearers and the rest will be told, with fitting shakti-yogas
from that union, wheel-joined rite gives all fruits
inference: Told wheel-bearers' fitting unions make the all-fruit wheel-rite.
plain_english: Wheel-bearers and the rest will be told, with fitting shakti-yogas — from that union, wheel-joined rite, all-fruit-giving.
